rooms.name: Ward
rooms.text: Our air-conditioned ward rooms provide a clean, spacious, and comfortable healing space, shared by four patients. Divided into Pediatric, Male, Female, and OB categories, each ward is designed for optimal patient care with essential amenities and 24/7 nursing support.

rooms.name: Semi-private Room
rooms.text: Designed for comfort and privacy, our air-conditioned semi-private rooms accommodate two patients, offering a spacious and well-equipped healing environment with essential amenities and 24/7 nursing support.

rooms.name: Private Room
rooms.text: Our air-conditioned private rooms ensure a comfortable and restful stay with enhanced privacy, essential amenities, and round-the-clock nursing care.

rooms.name: Suite
rooms.text: For a premium healing experience, our air-conditioned suite rooms offer spacious accommodations with exclusive amenities, personalized care, and 24/7 nursing support.

rooms.name: Isolation Room
rooms.text: Our isolation rooms provide a secure environment for patients requiring containment, equipped with filtration and infection control measures for safety.

rooms.name: Premium Labor Room
rooms.text: Our premium labor room provides an advanced, comfortable, and private environment for mothers during childbirth. Equipped with the newest facilities and a dedicated team of healthcare professionals, the room ensures a smooth and safe delivery experience. It is designed to provide a serene atmosphere for both mothers and their families, with necessary amenities to enhance comfort during labor.

facilities.name: HMO Hub
facilities.text: Facilitates access to healthcare services covered by your health insurance plan.
facilities.hours: 6 AM – 7 PM (Monday to Saturday), 6 AM – 2 PM (Sunday and Holidays)

facilities.name: Prayer Room
facilities.text: A peaceful chapel for prayer and reflection for patients, families, and staff.

facilities.name: Parking
facilities.text: Ample, convenient parking available for patients and visitors, with special slots for Persons with Disabilities (PWD) and Senior Citizens.
facilities.location: Basement Parking and Allocated Parking Space for Patients and Visitors

facilities.name: Dietary / Canteen
facilities.text: Our Dietary Services and Canteen offer a wide selection of meals that satisfy both cravings and care needs. From comfort food to medically tailored meal plans, every dish is prepared with your health and well-being in mind.

facilities.name: Automated Teller Machine (ATM)
facilities.text: Conveniently located ATM within the hospital ensure easy access to banking services for patients, visitors, and staff.

facilities.name: Breastfeeding Station
facilities.text: A comfortable and safe space for mothers to breastfeed their infants.

facilities.name: Pharmacy
facilities.text: Convenience and easy access to essential medications.
